_source: Genshin Impact Wiki — Stellar Glimmer Reaction, Stellar-Conduct, Stellar Swirl. Quoted, not paraphrased.
_rule: A Stellar Glimmer reaction only exists if a character with a Stellar Jubilee passive is in the party. Without one, Superconduct and Cryo Swirl stay ordinary. There is no artifact, weapon or stat that substitutes for this.

verdict.question: Can Varesa do Stellar-Conduct?
verdict.answer: Yes — as the Electro half. She can never enable it.
verdict.detail: Stellar-Conduct is Cryo onto Electro or Electro onto Cryo. Varesa supplies the Electro perfectly well. But the reaction only exists at all if someone in the party carries a Stellar Jubilee passive, and only three characters in the game have one. You own exactly one of them: the Traveler, in Cryo form.
verdict.catch: This is why "a Stellar-Conduct team without Cryo" cannot be built. Cryo is half the reaction by definition, and your only enabler is itself the Cryo Traveler.

enablers.name: Traveler (Cryo)
enablers.note: Yours, and the weakest of the three — half the base DMG bonus the 5-stars give. It still flips the reaction on, which is the part that matters.

reactions.name: Stellar-Conduct
reactions.text: Triggered by inflicting Cryo on a target already affected by Electro or vice versa. Creates a Starlight Prism, which briefly transforms the surrounding area into a Polestar Field.
reactions.warn: It deals no damage of its own. The Prism is the entire payoff — expecting a big number when it triggers is the usual mistake.

reactions.name: Stellar Swirl
reactions.text: Deals Anemo DMG and creates a Stellar Vortex that explodes after a delay for Cryo DMG. Triggering Stellar Swirl near an existing Vortex raises its level, so it hits harder over a larger area.
reactions.warn: An active Polestar Field cannot be converted to the other Stellar type, so a hybrid Conduct-plus-Swirl team does not work. Pick one.

field.name: Polestar Field
field.from: Starlight Prism, 7 seconds, sustained for as long as the Prism lives
effects: Stellar-Conduct's Base Reaction Coefficient (starts at 1) increases by 40%, plus 5% per recorded Cryo or Electro hit, up to 12 hits.
Characters inside gain +20% Cryo and Electro DMG Bonus — or +28% plus 1% per recorded hit, up to 12, once at least one hit lands.
All enemies inside have Physical RES reduced by 40%.
In the Snezhnayan open world, characters inside lose no heat or Kresnik Energy, and Kresnik below 30% is restored to 30%.
field.note: The hit that created the Prism does not count toward the tally. The count resets every 4 seconds, so the buffs want sustained Cryo and Electro application, not one big hit.

roster.name: Traveler
roster.why: Nothing happens without this. Must be in Cryo form, which you switch to at a Snezhnaya Statue of the Seven — the same trip that upgrades the Exaiphanes Blade.

roster.name: Varesa
roster.why: Supplies the Electro. Your highest-level character, so she is the obvious damage seat.

roster.name: Skirk
roster.why: Her passive creates a Void Rift when a nearby party member triggers Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl — so she converts the reaction straight into Serpent's Subtlety. This is the single best synergy you own.

roster.name: Alyosha
roster.why: Enters Radiance: Stellar-Conduct inside a Polestar Field, which adds +20% Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG while on field. His headline passive was inert on this account until now — this is what it was waiting for.

roster.name: Beidou
roster.why: Also enters the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state inside a Polestar Field.

roster.name: Sucrose
roster.why: Her passive fires on Swirl or Stellar Swirl, sharing 50 Elemental Mastery. If you go the Swirl route instead of Conduct, she is the Anemo.

roster.name: Escoffier
roster.why: Second-highest Cryo you own, and a stronger applier than most.

artifacts.text: 4pc: +12% ATK for 12s on triggering or dealing Stellar Glimmer DMG, and +50% Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG to all nearby party members. Works off-field.
4pc: +80% Superconduct and +40% Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG; +16% CRIT Rate when attacking enemies affected by either.
4pc: among much else, +20% Lunar-Charged and Stellar-Conduct DMG, and Elemental Skill CD reduced on trigger.
4pc: +16% CRIT Rate and +40% Stellar Swirl DMG for 10s after triggering Stellar Swirl.
4pc: +20% Stellar Swirl DMG, and a Stellar Swirl also drops the target's Cryo RES by 40%.
